preamble: A prothetic [e] is added before a word-initial cluster of s plus consonant, giving the cluster a syllable to begin with. Early Western Romance did this to Latin s impurum (status > Spanish estado, schola > Old French escole), and Spanish still does it to loanwords such as estrés and esnob. Basque, which has no initial s plus consonant, adds e- to Latin and modern loans (espiritu, eslogan). Persian adds e- before initial sp-, st-, sk- and sm- in loanwords (eski 'ski', estadium 'stadium').
